name: Raw A2A Send Message
description: Diagnostic escape hatch: send directly to an A2A URL with per-call Bearer authentication. Prefer importing an A2A agent asset.

url.description: Base URL of the remote A2A agent

taskId.description: Optional remote Task ID for continuation.

bearerSecret.description: Optional caller-owned SecretStore reference sent as HTTP Bearer auth.

bearerToken.description: Optional one-off literal Bearer token; redacted from Job records.

output.description: The final or interrupted remote A2A Task
